disposition_reason: Greenhouse phytotoxicity study at 400 mg/kg spiked soil; plant zirconium only in a figure; percentage effects on photosynthesis and a 40% uptake reduction under elevated CO2 are the usable numbers.

study.method: HNO3 digestion at 185 °C; quadrupole ICP-MS (820-MS), yttrium internal standard

non_numeric_findings: Zirconium at 400 mg/kg soil reduced oat biomass and photosynthesis and raised H2O2 and MDA (Results 3.1 to 3.3).
Elevated CO2 (710 ppm) cut oat zirconium by about 40% and restored growth (Results 3.1, p. 5).
